properties.site-address: Development Site Bounded By Ebury Street, Pimlico Road, Avery Farm Row, Ebury Square And Cundy Street, London
properties.notes: Demolition of Lochmore House, Kylestrom House, Laxford House and Style House (the Cundy Street flats). Demolition of Walden House. Redevelopment to provide new residential housing blocks with a mixture of private and affordable housing, retail units and community space. Provision of new public realm and routes through the site. Construction of new basement to provide off street parking.
